method: Lossless 2x2 repeat and half-width/half-height wrap offset; compare seam MAE against every interior boundary. Numeric screen: each wrap MAE <= max(2x interior median, interior p99). Visual inspection is still required; this screen cannot prove grain continuity or absence of large-scale repetition.
visual_review: Inspected original, full 2x2 repeat, and 512 px wrap offset at native 1024 px. Dark warm horizontal walnut grain and small knots are plausible, but a vertical join interrupts grain in the repeat and offset. Numeric screen passes narrowly (LR ratio 1.896); its edge MAE is worse than every interior boundary. Visual rejection takes precedence.
